import os, subprocess, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path(r"__ROOTDIR__")
PY=sys.executable
def run(cmd, timeout=600):
    e=dict(os.environ); e["PYTHONPATH"]=str(ROOT)+os.pathsep+e.get("PYTHONPATH",""); e.pop("PYTHONHOME",None)
    return subprocess.run(cmd,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,cwd=str(ROOT),env=e,timeout=timeout)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
    tmp=Path(tmp)
    proc=run([PY,"-m","pip","wheel",".","--no-build-isolation","-w",str(tmp)])
    print("wheel rc",proc.returncode, proc.stdout.decode('utf-8','replace')[-800:], proc.stderr.decode('utf-8','replace')[-800:])
    wheels=sorted(tmp.glob("hone-*.whl")); print("wheels",wheels)
    wheel=wheels[-1]
    venv=tmp/"venv"
    proc=run([PY,"-m","venv",str(venv)],timeout=300)
    print("venv rc",proc.returncode, proc.stderr.decode('utf-8','replace')[-500:])
    vpy=venv/("Scripts/python.exe" if os.name=="nt" else "bin/python")
    print("vpy exists",vpy.exists())
    proc=run([str(vpy),"-m","pip","install","--no-index","--no-deps",str(wheel)],timeout=300)
    print("install rc",proc.returncode, proc.stdout.decode('utf-8','replace')[-1500:], proc.stderr.decode('utf-8','replace')[-1500:])
    env=dict(os.environ); env.pop("PYTHONPATH",None)
    proc=subprocess.run([str(vpy),"-c","import sys; print(sys.executable); print(sys.path); import hone; from hone.hone import Hone; print(hone.Hone is Hone)"],stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,cwd=str(tmp),env=env,timeout=120)
    print("import rc",proc.returncode)
    print("OUT",proc.stdout.decode('utf-8','replace'))
    print("ERR",proc.stderr.decode('utf-8','replace'))
    print("site",[x.name for x in (venv/"Lib/site-packages").glob('*')])
'@.Replace('__ROOTDIR__',$p) | Set-Content -Encoding UTF8 $dbg; python $dbg 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 60
